questions.text: There is 5/3 liter of juice. A serving is 5/4 liter. How many servings, including fractional servings, are available?

questions.text: Without calculating exactly, what must be true about 3 ÷ 1/2?
answers: It is negative because the divisor is a fraction
It is greater than 3 because half-unit pieces fit more times
It is less than 3 because division always makes smaller
It equals 3 because the numerator is 1
questions.explanation: Six half-unit pieces fit into three wholes. Division by a positive number below 1 increases the result.
